\section{\texttt{run\_experiment}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.experiments.run_experiment}\index{Functions!run\_experiment}

Execute one experiment end to end and return the typed result.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
run_experiment(config: ExperimentConfig) -> ExperimentResult
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{config}] \texttt{ExperimentConfig}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Value}\texttt{ExperimentResult}
\apifield{Details}The index is built in memory from the configured dataset using the configured chunking and embedding parameters, so experiments never touch the persisted application index.
